title: MALLM-GAN: Multi-Agent Large Language Model as Generative Adversarial Network for Synthesizing Tabular Data
summary: MALLM-GAN is a multi-agent LLM-based generative method for synthesizing tabular data, paired with baseline pipelines and evaluation scripts. The baseline notebook fits SDV's CTGANSynthesizer and TVAESynthesizer on a SingleTableMetadata object, and eval_utils.py builds an sdmetrics QualityReport, so SDV is run as a comparison baseline and evaluation tool against the proposed method.
